children.text: Lumina Fintech is an AI loan platform in Malaysia. The challenge was making a serious financial product feel trustworthy to everyday borrowers while still reading as modern and innovation-led.
We built a scalable framework of reusable sections with a clear call-to-action hierarchy, so new feature pages keep the same rhythm without needing a redesign each time.
The result behaves like a working product rather than a brochure: live match scores, a loan comparison dashboard, and six calculators that answer real questions before anyone applies.
